install_steps: curl -L -o devpod https://github.com/loft-sh/devpod/releases/latest/download/devpod-linux-amd64 && sudo install -o root -g root -m 0755 devpod /usr/local/bin
note: DevPod CLI is client-only — the desktop app is optional. A provider must be configured before `devpod up`: `devpod provider add docker` (local) is the simplest. Use `--ide none` for headless/agent workflows and `devpod ssh` to exec into the environment.
